response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with roughly 15 years of full-stack work, including recent hands-on TypeScript/Node.js product development, AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience (a rare and explicitly required skill), cloud (AWS CDK), Docker/Kubernetes, and a strong testing/TDD culture. Gaps are mostly around specific framework alignment: no explicit Nest.js or Vitest/Jest experience, frontend history skews toward Ember.js over React, and Kotlin exposure is absent, but these are learnable given the demonstrated breadth.
strengths: Direct AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Deep full-stack TypeScript/Node.js experience with cloud (AWS), Docker/Kubernetes, and MongoDB/SQL
Strong engineering craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, code katas, workshops, and open-source testing tools
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned anywhere in the resume
Frontend experience leans heavily on Ember.js; React appears only in one role
No Kotlin experience and limited recent Java; Vitest/Jest/Playwright not explicitly named

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and limited React depth
